question_text: Each student in Ms. Jordan's science class was given a beaker containing several substances that had been stirred thoroughly. Maxwell must classify the contents of his beaker as either a compound or a mixture. Which of the following would indicate that the beaker contains a mixture?

B: The contents of the beaker reacted to form a new substance.
C: The original substances had a greater mass than the contents of the beaker.
D: The contents of the beaker can be easily separated into the original substances.
